note: Drive 0.6 mi from the dam on the south shore. Limited parking: a dirt pullout (about 3 cars) just east of the crag on the south side, one across the road, or a lakeside pullout west toward the dam (5-6 cars).
Park on Highway 18 about 1 mile from the dam; the lot is about 200 ft past the small signed trailhead, on the left. The trail to Castle Rock is about 1.2 mi and mostly uphill.
